name: Busa Feedback
description: Voice-of-customer desk: raw feedback, clustered feature requests, and the roadmap decision queue

agentPrompts.label: What needs my attention right now?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-feedback` skill in this folder, then open the overview and summarize roadmap decisions waiting, new uncategorized feedback, and requests needing more info.

agentPrompts.label: Triage the inbox
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-feedback` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then work through the new feedback in the inbox — assign each item to a request, ignore it, or mark it insight.

agentPrompts.label: Review roadmap proposals
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-feedback` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the roadmap decision queue one proposal at a time so I can approve, request changes, or block each. Any outbound reply or changelog publish only happens after I approve and stays `handoff_ready` until I separately confirm execution.
